label: log(C_i[t+21]/C_i[t+1])-log(C_SPY[t+21]/C_SPY[t+1]) > 0
decision: features observed at t close; modeled entry t+1 close; exit t+21 close
fit: annual expanding pooled ridge logistic; training label end strictly before test year; train-only scaling and clipping +/-5; ridge mean-loss lambda=0.01; intercept unpenalized; no tuning

models.combined: baseline plus all three candidate families

primary_metric: paired out-of-sample Brier improvement versus baseline; positive means candidate better
secondary_metrics: return direction by ticker and market regime

inference.bootstrap: 1000 circular moving-block resamples of daily cross-sectional mean Brier differences; block60 observed sessions; seed14102026
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction for four candidate-versus-baseline tests in holdout; no retraining/tuning after results
inference.promotion_gate: mean Brier gain>=0.002, 95% block CI above0, Holm p<0.05, no negative mean gain in development, and no severe regime concentration; a pass only permits further validation, never live authority

diagnostics.nonoverlap: every20th eligible decision session; long top3 vs SPY using equal weights, compare baseline and combined; 10/30bp full-switch round-trip deductions per20-session interval; not a portfolio strategy or executable-quote proof
diagnostics.pivot: RS20 changes sign and keeps new sign for5sessions; alert episodes at p>=0.6 or<=0.4 while RS20 is opposite; 20session cooldown; report fraction with matching pivot within20sessions, lead time only among true matches; probabilities target returns, not pivot probability
diagnostics.incident: separately recompute June24-July2 2026 defensive/semis returns and bps units; do not mix into2018-2025 results

caveats: Later-vintage vendor snapshots, not original availability vintages
Selected surviving ETF set; SMH predecessor/index changes not a constant economic basket
No constituent breadth, true signed trades, options, or dealer inventory claims
XLC and XLRE become eligible only after actual history plus warmup; never backfill before inception
Feature windows, model families and threshold set before outcomes; bug corrections retained explicitly
Historical holdout is unconsulted by this pilot before run, not pristine prospective data across the organization
